Record-Breaking Victory in Sydney

Australia's women's rugby league team secured a dominant victory over Wales during the final match of the group phase at the Women’s Rugby League World Cup held at Commbank Stadium in Sydney.

Match Highlights and Statistics

  • Final Score: Australia defeated Wales by a substantial margin.
  • Key Performers: Jaime Chapman recorded multiple tries for Australia, while teammate Jesse Southwell contributed significantly through successful conversions from the tee.
  • Milestones: The match saw several tournament and international records broken for scoring margins in women's rugby league.
  • Wales' Score: Despite the scoreline, Wales managed to register points on the board during the fixture.

Tournament Context and Upcoming Fixtures

The fixture concluded the pool phase of the tournament. Confirmed upcoming matches for the knockout stages include:

  • Australia vs. Fiji: Scheduled for Sunday in Sydney, with the winner advancing to the World Cup final.
  • New Zealand vs. Samoa: Scheduled for Saturday in Newcastle to determine the other potential finalist.
